raw_text: Maxar Technologies has released high-resolution imagery of the Kakhovka Dam breach. Before-and-after comparison at 30cm resolution confirms complete destruction of the dam's central spillway section. Road bridge across the dam is entirely severed. Reservoir water level has dropped by approximately 5 meters in 6 hours.
